longStrings.long.faq.a1: Nam blong yu i "Kood blong National ID" mo paswod i kriet random long sistem mo i send long namba blong Shad we yu bin rejista. Long olgeta yusa — long hed blong skul i go kasem studen — rod blong login i sem. Afta long fas login, jenisim paswod blong yu long seksen profil; hem i obligatori blong sekyuriti blong akaont.
longStrings.long.faq.a10: Bara long final ripot, بهار i mekem wan samari blong performans blong wanwan studen long evri manis: averes blong mak long sem manis, ol dei blong present mo absent mo ol homwok blong manis ia. Samari ia i so long studen mo papa/mama long seksen blong mak, blong oli luk progres manis long manis.
longStrings.long.faq.a1NoShad: Nam blong yu i "Kood blong National ID" mo paswod i kriet random long sistem mo hed blong skul i givim long yu. Long olgeta yusa — long hed blong skul i go kasem studen — rod blong login i sem. Afta long fas login, jenisim paswod blong yu long seksen profil; hem i obligatori blong sekyuriti blong akaont.
longStrings.long.faq.a2: Ringim hed blong skul blong yu. Long panel blong yusa, hed i save mekem wan niu random paswod blong yu mo sendem long yu tru long Shad. Ol paswod i stap save enkripted mo no wan — nomo hed — i save luk paswod blong yu nao; hem i save mekem niu paswod nomo.

longStrings.long.faq.a3: Internal mesenja i designed nomo blong ol sot mo light mesij blong server blong sistem i stap kwik oltaem. Blong sendem fae, foto mo big content, yusim Shad; بهار i rimindem yu long dis point long internal mesenja.

longStrings.long.faq.a4: Web version i ran long evri browser mo sem version ia i instal olsem app long Android mo Windows; hem i wan akaont, trifala platform. Android version tu i stap givim long skul olsem independent APK fae.
longStrings.long.faq.a5: Ol paswod i mekem wetem safe cryptographic generator mo i save olsem hash. Afta sam failed trae, akaont i lock temporarily mo jenisim paswod afta fas login i obligatori. بهار i no save keepim any paswod long plain text.
